Title: LSJ : Heidelburg Castle and Femur of Toomler

Messages.Author: Tim Wang
Messages.Body:
Can I use a Tzimisce to equip Femur of Toomler, then use Heidelburg
Castle to transfer it to a non-Tzimische minion? Or does must the
recipient also be Tzimisce?

Thanks,
Tim

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Can I use a Tzimisce to equip Femur of Toomler, then use Heidelburg
>Castle to transfer it to a non-Tzimische minion?

Yes.

>Or does must the
>recipient also be Tzimisce?

No. You only have to be a Tzimisce when initially equipping the Femur (i.e.
putting it into play). You do not need to be a Tzimisce to use it. Compare to
the text on Sword of Judgment for example.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: Pepijn
Messages.Body:
ti...@hotmail.com (Tim Wang) wrote in message news:<703e9d27.04071...@posting.google.com>...

> Can I use a Tzimisce to equip Femur of Toomler, then use Heidelburg
> Castle to transfer it to a non-Tzimische minion? Or does must the
> recipient also be Tzimisce?

The first.

Requirements are only required to put the card into play. If card text
allows a vampire/minion to use it, then it doesn't need to be of the
required clan.

Messages.Author: Hardy Range
Messages.Body:
ti...@hotmail.com (Tim Wang) wrote in message news:<703e9d27.04071...@posting.google.com>...

> Can I use a Tzimisce to equip Femur of Toomler, then use Heidelburg
> Castle to transfer it to a non-Tzimische minion? Or does must the
> recipient also be Tzimisce?
>

You can do that.

Note that in some cases, equipment will only work when used by
vampires from certain clans, as specified by card text (e.g., Sword of
Judgement). But even in these cases, you may move the equipment to
minions _not_ belonging to that clan - they just cannot use it.

The Femur of Toomler, on the other hand, has no such clauses - every
minion may use it.

Regards,
